title: Release Tools Audit — Universal Scheduler Phase 7A

executors: compress_release.py: ProcessPoolExecutor fallback only (scheduler primary since Phase 6B)
summary.retry: upload: network backoff 3x; download: HF-library managed; all others none
summary.resume: upload: remote-size skip; download: HF-library managed; dedup: none (re-run from source)
summary.resource_awareness: none for dedup (raw CLI --jobs); upload threads network-bound; download reads acquisition config
summary.migration_verdict: dedup -> Universal Scheduler (category tasks, registry dedup stage); upload/publish -> documented exemption-by-design + hardening; join/checksums/verify/promote/index/metadata/download -> keep sequential (documented)

entry_points.invoked_by: manual; tests/test_join_release.py (10 tests); no production callers

entry_points.type: CLI script (sequential; HF snapshot_download internally parallel)

related_out_of_scope.note: v1.8-era bundle builder (build_release) used by e2e_pipeline.py / publish_agent.py / automation_runner.py; no concurrent.futures usage; not the v1.0 release pipeline; inventoried for completeness only

release_chain: promote_release.py -> NEW frozen manifest (RC->final), chain signed [sequential, governance]
publish_promotion.py -> HF server-side copy + metadata/docs upload [sequential, 1 commit]
upload_huggingface.py -> full HF upload (repo create, resume, verify, index) [TPE per section]
download_release.py -> restore from HF + checksum verify [sequential; HF-managed parallel]

passes: pass1: stream approved.jsonl; write full records inline; index review stubs into stub_meta
pass2: resolve stubs by scanning raw/generated/*_atlas.jsonl (id match -> merge_record)
pass3: resolve remaining stubs from pilot/curated dirs
join.parallelization_hazard: cross-pass stub index + global dedup; high complexity, low value; keep sequential

worker.name: dedup_category
worker.args_shape: (src: Path, dst: Path, cat_stats: dict) — stats returned via passed mutable dict
behavior: keep first occurrence per record ID
drop subsequent occurrences ONLY when byte-identical (SHA-256 of raw line)
keep + flag conflicting duplicates (never silently dropped)
worker.executor_wrapper: dedup_category_worker(src: str, dst: str) -> dict (str args for pool)

executor.completion: as_completed then per-category stats aggregated in submission order
executor.resume: none (re-run from source; completed categories wasted)
executor.crash_behavior: partial .zst possible; re-run rewrites from source (idempotent but wasteful)

serialized_finalize: build_manifest signs new manifest chained to source chain_hash

checksums_verify.generate: walk release root, sort relative paths, stream SHA-256, never checksum the checksum file, sha256sum format
checksums_verify.verify: 31 checks: structure, zst decompress+count per category, checksums all-match, stats consistency, release metadata parse
checksums_verify.executor: none (pure sequential, O(1) memory, deterministic order)

steps: collect local files + plan sections (dataset, metadata, docs)
resume: _remote_sizes via list_repo_files + get_paths_info; _resume_skip keeps files missing or size-mismatched
upload pending sections via _upload_section_with_retry (one upload_folder commit per section; 3x retry 2s*2^(n-1) backoff)
_verify_remote: existence + SIZE ONLY (remote sha256 fetched but never compared)
gaps: verification size-only — same-size corrupted blob passes
--workers default 4 hardcoded, not wired to release.upload_workers
get_paths_info with all remote paths, no pagination guard

publish_promote.promote: governance: source exists, dest NOT exists, status release_candidate/final, chain_hash present; NEW manifest status=final; stats/sources/gates verbatim; sha256-chain-v1; self-verifies signature; refuses write on mismatch; --dry-run writes nothing
publish_promote.publish: enumerate remote source files, ONE create_commit with ALL CommitOperationCopy ops + metadata CommitOperationAdd ops, commit, presence verify
publish_risks: batch CommitOperationCopy in one commit has proven silent-drop mode (Phase 5 runbook: one commit per file)
no destination-existence pre-check -> duplicate-publish risk on re-run

download.verify: downloaded tree vs its own checksums.sha256 (missing/mismatch/extra)
download.quirk: reads acquisition stage config, not release/download key

merge_order_guarantees.dedup_report: per-category in CATEGORIES iteration order (sequential); scheduler must sort by task_id
merge_order_guarantees.zstd: single-threaded frames at fixed level — byte-deterministic per file

join.note: hard exit 1 on validation failure (correct: gate)

dedup.note: re-run from source; wasted completed categories

publish.note: network; must NOT auto-retry blindly (duplicate risk)

dedup.ram: O(1) streaming + per-category seen dict (~1M ids)

becomes_scheduler_task: dedup: one task per category, id dedup:{release}:{cat} (release embedded — repo-global registry)
dedup worker dedup_task wraps dedup_category verbatim (same worker as old PPE -> byte-identical)
dedup worker raises on error -> scheduler retry (max_retries=2); terminal failure exits 1
dedup retry rewrites only that category's output ('wb' overwrite) -> no duplicates
dedup pool=process (CPU-bound zstd+hash; pure worker -> no SQLite fork hazard on macOS)
dedup workers from resolve_worker_count('release') with new release.dedup_workers key; --jobs stays as CLI override
remains_serialized: join passes 1/2/3 (cross-pass stub index + global dedup + manifest gate)
dedup finalize: compute_statistics + build_manifest + report + exit code
requires_network_retry: publish_promotion (currently none; if hardened, add idempotent dest-exists check BEFORE retry; prefer per-file commits)
requires_human_approval_gate: promote (RC->final): dry-run + explicit user sign-off (skill rule); never a scheduler task
publish/upload (HF write): docs rule 'never upload before explicit human instruction'; manual CLI only
dedup (creates new RC + signed manifest): safe to automate; never mutates frozen artifacts; signed manifest is the gate
registry_state: task_id, status (pending/running/completed/failed/retry/skipped), attempt, timestamp, error, record_count telemetry
task_id MUST embed release: dedup:{release}:{cat} — registry is repo-global; bare dedup:{cat} collides across releases
migration_boundary.cannot_parallelize: dedup categories are disjoint per file but the finalize (stats+manifest) requires ALL categories; join's stub index is cross-pass shared state

config.py.note: resolve_worker_count('release') -> 4 today (upload_workers; compress_workers added 6B). Need release.dedup_workers key. Env override ATLAS_WORKERS_RELEASE works.

resource.py.note: safe_worker_limit() fits CPU-bound zstd+hash dedup; per-task RAM 512MB generous; disk_free() reporting-only (5E R1 — still not wired; dedup rewrites ~5GB)

models.py.note: Task/TaskResult fit category tasks; extra={source_dataset, target_dataset, expect_total}

registry.py.note: TaskRegistry(root, 'dedup') -> task_registry_dedup.jsonl; lease re-claim 900s; attempts() from append-only file

planner.py.note: file_tasks() could build per-category tasks but id must be dedup:{release}:{cat}; plan inline like plan_compress_tasks for exact id control

scheduler.py.note: bounded submission, retry <= max_retries, resume-skip, deterministic sort by task_id, in-run dedupe; pool=process; _backpressure() still dead code (out of scope)

monitor.py.note: Monitor writes reports/performance/dedup_scheduler_report.json; not required for correctness

findings.finding: Dedup has PPE but no registry/retry/resume; crash mid-category loses completed categories' work on re-run (rewrites from source)
findings.impact: Scheduler adoption (registry + lease + resume) closes this; per-category tasks make re-run incremental

findings.finding: Dedup worker count is raw CLI --jobs (default 1), no RAM/CPU caps; 9 categories -> sequential by default
findings.impact: release.dedup_workers key + resolve_worker_count('release'); --jobs stays as override

findings.finding: Dedup manifest/statistics finalize MUST stay serialized after all category tasks (signed content_hash over complete stats)
findings.impact: 5C pure workers + serialized finalize; finalize consumes sorted task results, builds stats + manifest exactly as today

findings.finding: Upload verification is size-only: remote sha256 fetched but never compared; same-size corrupted blob passes
findings.impact: Harden _verify_remote to compare local vs remote sha256 (LFS sha256 available via get_paths_info expand)

findings.finding: Upload --workers default 4 hardcoded, not wired to release.upload_workers
findings.impact: Wire default via resolve_worker_count('release') (value coincidentally 4 today)

findings.finding: Publish uses one batch commit with many CommitOperationCopy ops — proven silent-drop mode (Phase 5 runbook: one commit per file)
findings.impact: Harden: one commit per file (runbook pattern) or verify each copied path post-commit; currently only presence-checked

findings.finding: Publish has no destination-existence pre-check -> duplicate-publish risk on re-run
findings.impact: Check dst in remote before copy (mirror upload's resume skip); skip existing

findings.finding: Publish does not call update_release_index (v1.0 index entry exists — updated manually per promotion runbook)
findings.impact: Document; optionally auto-update after verified publish

findings.finding: Download reads acquisition worker config, not a release/download key
findings.impact: Cosmetic; leave or add release.download_workers when touched

findings.finding: Join is sequential by design (cross-pass stub index, global dedup, manifest gate) — parallelizing is high-risk/low-value
findings.impact: Keep sequential; document in design doc

findings.finding: Checksums/verify/build_metadata are pure sequential functions — no migration value
Promote is correctly sequential + dry-run gated; must never become a scheduler task
No test coverage for dedup_release.py, promote_release.py, publish_promotion.py, build_release_metadata.py
findings.impact: Add tests/test_scheduler_dedup.py (planning/retry/resume/determinism) + smoke tests for promote/publish dry-run paths in 7B

decisions_needed.question: Registry stage key
options: dedup (-> task_registry_dedup.jsonl, isolates from compression and future upload)
release (shared stage for all release tools)
decisions_needed.recommendation: dedup — per-stage separation keeps each pipeline's state inspectable; task_ids carry operation prefix so a future shared release registry is still possible

decisions_needed.question: Task unit
decisions_needed.recommendation: category-level — source is already one .zst per category; splitting inside a category breaks byte-identical dedup (seen dict spans the category)

decisions_needed.question: Worker config key
decisions_needed.recommendation: new key dedup_workers — separate concern, clear logs, env override ATLAS_WORKERS_RELEASE still applies

decisions_needed.question: Failure semantics
options: worker raises on error (retryable, mirrors compression D4)
decisions_needed.recommendation: raise -> retry; terminal failure after max_retries exits 1 (same final semantics)

decisions_needed.question: Upload hardening scope (F4/F5)
options: fix _verify_remote sha256 comparison + wire --workers default in same phase as 7B
decisions_needed.recommendation: include — small, high-value, no scheduler dependency

decisions_needed.question: Publish hardening scope (F6/F7)
options: design now, implement with explicit approval (touches HF write behavior)
decisions_needed.recommendation: design as part of this design doc but implement only with explicit approval; test in dry-run/list-only mode first
